_metadata.description: Machine-readable trust anchor registry for Longivity. Every system output traces to one of these anchors.

anchor_types.DETERMINISTIC_FORMULA: Published mathematical formula. Same inputs always produce same output. Cannot hallucinate.
anchor_types.MR_VALIDATED: Mendelian Randomization causal evidence. Genetically-instrumented causal estimate — stronger than observational association.
anchor_types.DETERMINISTIC_LOOKUP: Published lookup table. Deterministic from SNP genotype. Cannot hallucinate.
anchor_types.PUBLISHED_THRESHOLD: Threshold from peer-reviewed publication. Applied deterministically to wearable values.

anchors.name: PhenoAge Biological Age Formula
anchors.citation: Levine ME et al. Aging Cell. 2018. PMID 29676998
anchors.claim: 9-biomarker Gompertz mortality model. Deterministic to <0.001yr. Validated in NHANES III/IV. Predicts 10-year mortality better than chronological age alone.
anchors.what_it_proves: Hidden biological aging invisible to standard annual physicals. A 58yo with T2D can have the biology of a 73yo.

anchors.name: ACC/AHA Pooled Cohort Equations (ASCVD)
anchors.citation: Goff DC Jr et al. J Am Coll Cardiol. 2014. PMID 24222018
anchors.claim: 4 sex/race strata. 10-year ASCVD risk. Validated in REGARDS and MESA cohorts. Standard of care in ACC/AHA guidelines.
anchors.what_it_proves: Cardiovascular event risk over 10 years. Combined with PhenoAge, surfaces patients whose arteries are aging faster than their calendar age.

anchors.name: Omega-3 Fatty Acids → PhenoAge Deceleration (Mendelian Randomization)
anchors.citation: Fabian CJ et al. Human Genomics. 2025. DOI 10.1186/s40246-025-00756-3
anchors.claim: Oily fish intake causally decreases PhenoAge acceleration. IVW p=0.0086. Fish oil supplementation causally decreases GrimAge. IVW p=0.037. Genetically-instrumented — not confounded by healthy user bias.

anchors.name: Vitamin D3 → GrimAge Deceleration (Mendelian Randomization)
anchors.citation: Hagenbeek FA et al. Twin Research and Human Genetics. 2022. PMID 36055464
anchors.claim: Genetically predicted 25-OHD serum levels causally associated with lower GrimAge. IVW p=0.04. Twin study design controls for shared environment.

anchors.name: Folate Intake → PhenoAge Deceleration (Mendelian Randomization)
anchors.citation: Fabian CJ et al. Human Genomics. 2025. DOI 10.1186/s40246-025-00756-3
anchors.claim: Folate intake MR signal for PhenoAge deceleration via homocysteine pathway. IVW p=0.03. Critical for MTHFR compound heterozygous carriers (~50% enzyme activity).

anchors.name: Metformin Pathway → Biological Age Deceleration (Mendelian Randomization)
anchors.citation: Dugué PA et al. Aging Cell. 2021. PMID 34385711
anchors.claim: Genetically predicted lower fasting glucose causally reduces PhenoAge acceleration. IVW p=0.02. Metformin acts on this pathway (AMPK/mTOR). Glucose is the #1 PhenoAge accelerator by coefficient (0.1953).

anchors.name: APOE Diplotype Table (rs429358 + rs7412)
anchors.citation: Corder EH et al. Science. 1993. PMID 8346443
anchors.claim: Two SNPs (rs429358 + rs7412) deterministically determine APOE genotype e2/e2 through e4/e4. e4/e4 = 8-12× elevated Alzheimer's disease risk. Cannot hallucinate — pure lookup table.
anchors.what_it_proves: Genetic risk that contradicts biomarker signal. A patient with PhenoAge 33yr (−19yr deceleration) can simultaneously carry 8-12× AD risk.

anchors.name: MTHFR Enzyme Activity Table (C677T + A1298C)
anchors.citation: Frosst P et al. Nature Genetics. 1995. PMID 8554066
anchors.claim: C677T (rs1801133) + A1298C (rs1801131) compound heterozygous → ~50% MTHFR enzyme activity. Impairs folate metabolism and methylation. Deterministic from genotype.
anchors.what_it_proves: Methylation enzyme running at 50% capacity. Folate/5-MTHF supplementation is the evidence-based intervention.

anchors.name: HRV RMSSD Longevity Thresholds
anchors.citation: Shaffer F & Ginsberg JP. Front Public Health. 2017. PMID 29034226
anchors.claim: OPTIMAL ≥50ms, MODERATE 30-50ms, HIGH_RISK <30ms. Maps to mitochondrial_dysfunction and altered_intercellular_communication hallmarks.
anchors.what_it_proves: Autonomic nervous system health. HRV 22ms (Dorothy) = HIGH_RISK mitochondrial dysfunction invisible to standard labs.

anchors.name: VO2max Longevity Thresholds
anchors.citation: Ross R et al. Circulation. 2016. PMID 27881567
anchors.claim: OPTIMAL ≥45 mL/kg/min, MODERATE 30-45, HIGH_RISK <30. Maps to mitochondrial_dysfunction, stem_cell_exhaustion, cellular_senescence.
anchors.what_it_proves: Cardiorespiratory fitness — strongest single predictor of all-cause mortality. VO2max 24 (Dorothy) = HIGH_RISK, equivalent to frailty trajectory.

anchors.name: Daily Steps Longevity Thresholds
anchors.citation: Paluch AE et al. JAMA Intern Med. 2022. PMID 35416941
anchors.claim: OPTIMAL ≥8000 steps/day, MODERATE 5000-8000, HIGH_RISK <5000. Maps to cellular_senescence and mitochondrial_dysfunction.
anchors.what_it_proves: Physical activity dose-response for longevity. 3200 steps/day (Dorothy) = HIGH_RISK senescence trajectory.
